description: Retention/lifecycle daemon from Appendix A. Nightly check for exemptions past valid_until in mcp_exemptions table. Reads valid_until column, marks expired records by setting status='expired' or removing them per policy. Must write heartbeat to service_health every 60s. Use write_service at :8772 for all DB access. No direct duckdb imports. Pure function for date checking allowed. Scan interval: 24h.
